title: E2SIM: Long-Horizon Simulation of Everyday Human Behavior with Evolving States
abstract: arXiv:2611.31641v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents are increasingly expected to support users over long periods, across work, and daily life. This requires modeling not only who users are, but also how their goals, interests, activities, and interactions evolve over time. A challenge in longitudinal user simulation is maintaining consistency between these evolving states and the consequences of actions in a shared environment. We introduce E2SIM, a longitudinal user simulation framework that jointly models evolving actor states and a dynamic shared environment. E2SIM connects actor-state updates with shared-world changes through a feedback loop linking immediate actions, delayed outcomes, and actor-specific observations across work and life. This allows the consequences of earlier actions to shape later behavior, while preserving differences in what each actor knows. translated_title: E2SIM：基于演化状态的日常人类行为长期模拟
translated_abstract: AI 智能体越来越被期望能够在长期内、跨工作与日常生活为用户提供支持。这不仅需要建模用户是谁，还需要建模他们的目标、兴趣、活动和互动如何随时间演变。纵向用户模拟的一大挑战在于保持这些演化状态与共享环境中行动后果之间的一致性。我们提出了 E2SIM，一个联合建模行动者演化状态与动态共享环境的纵向用户模拟框架。E2SIM 通过一个反馈循环将行动者状态更新与共享世界的变化相连接，该循环串联了即时行动、延迟结果以及跨工作与生活的行动者特定观察。这使得早期行动的后果能够影响后续行为，同时保留每个行动者所知信息的差异。我们进一步提出了一套纵向轨迹诊断指标，用于衡量动态一致性、连贯事件……
tldr: E2SIM 提出了一个通过反馈循环将行动者演化状态与动态共享环境联合建模的纵向用户模拟框架，使早期行动的后果能够塑造后续行为，同时保留各行动者视角的差异，并配套了衡量动态一致性的纵向轨迹诊断指标。
en_tdlr: E2SIM introduces a longitudinal user simulation framework that jointly models evolving actor states and a dynamic shared environment through a feedback loop linking immediate actions, delayed outcomes, and actor-specific observations, enabling earlier actions' consequences to shape later behavior while preserving per-actor knowledge differences.
